references.text: The original instruction for the ephod, specifying that it shall have two shoulder pieces attached to its two ends.
Describes how the breastpiece is to be attached to the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
The immediate context describing the materials and making of the ephod to which the shoulder pieces are connected.
Shows how the breastpiece was attached to the shoulder pieces of the ephod, in accordance with God's instructions.
The same Hebrew root 'חבר' (to join together) is used for the joining of the curtains in the tabernacle.
